'''Frenzy''' is a ranged [[attack]] that grants [[frenzy charge]]s on hit and also gains large bonuses from them. It requires a [[bow]] or [[wand]].

==Skill functions and interactions==
{{c|mod|More Attack Damage per Frenzy Charge}}: Frenzy deals more [[hit]] damage based on the player's current charges. Damage is calculated before on-hit effects, including its own charge gain. 

Like most skills, Frenzy is limited in [[Charge#Charge_gain|charge gain]]. Per attack or [[trigger]], Frenzy can only gain 1 Frenzy charge from [[hit]]s, regardless of multiple [[projectiles]], mechanics like [[chain]], or [[repeat]]s from e.g. [[Fatal Flourish]].
